description: US drug acquisition cost (NADAC) — What US pharmacies pay for a drug: CMS NADAC weekly per-unit acquisition cost by drug name + strength (e.g. lisinopril 10) or 11-digit NDC. Groups package NDCs by product with median/min/max per-unit cost, pricing unit, generic/brand, OTC flag, estimated cost of 30 units; ndc= adds recent weekly price history and trend. US government data; not a retail price. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_drug_price
